title: Vanity Top Toilet Tissue Holder, Solid Brass, 5.5-Inch | Mediterranean Blue | Vanity Top Accessories | Allied Brass
body_html:
Keep toilet paper within easy reach when wall space is limited—this vanity top toilet tissue holder places a roll right on the counter for clean, convenient access in Mediterranean Blue, which presents a deep, sophisticated blue with subtle purple undertones, evoking the rich depths of coastal waters for a bold yet refined statement.

  • Mediterranean Blue transforms this essential into a conversation piece
  • Choose from 28 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
  • Built to last: Solid brass construction for long-term durability.
  • Coordinated style: Part of the Vanity Top Accessories collection for a cohesive, transitional bathroom hardware look with multiple designer finish options.

Specs
Product dimensions (L x H x W): 5.5 x 6 x 5 in.
Box dimensions (L x H x W): 12 x 10 x 6 in.
Shipping weight: 5 lbs
Warranty: Limited lifetime warranty
Assembly: Assembled in the USA
